note: Pointers only. No issue text, no source, no diff. Rebuild: select-candidates.mjs fetch && select.

threshold_choices.question: Which link between issue and PR counts as "closed by a merged fixing PR"
options: a: any merged PR in closedByPullRequestsReferences (GitHub fills this only for PRs into the default branch)
b: exactly one merged, non-excluded PR in closedByPullRequestsReferences, and the issue stateReason is COMPLETED
c: exactly one merged, non-excluded PR whose closing set (GitHub link, or a GitHub closing keyword + issue number in the PR body, any base branch) contains the issue, and stateReason is COMPLETED
threshold_choices.note: b is narrower in count but keeps only PRs merged straight into main (all static passes fell in 2026-04/05); c is the conservative choice for the memorisation risk and matches the plan wording "exclude integration PRs". Count under b is recorded as stage1_github_link_only_count.

threshold_choices.question: PR that closes several issues (the request text would be ambiguous)
options: a: keep
b: reject unless the PR closes exactly one issue

threshold_choices.question: What "800 lines" counts
options: a: additions only
b: additions + deletions (git numstat, first parent .. merge commit)

threshold_choices.question: What a "unit test" file is
options: a: any *.test.ts collected by vitest (tests/unit + tests/integration)
b: tests/unit/**/*.test.ts or src/**/*.{test,spec}.ts only; a PR touching tests/integration/ is rejected

threshold_choices.question: Rune modules (*.svelte.ts / *.svelte.js) under the ".svelte" exclusion
options: a: only *.svelte
b: *.svelte and *.svelte.ts / *.svelte.js

threshold_choices.question: What "DB migration" covers
options: a: drizzle/ and **/migration(s)/ and *.sql
b: a + any file whose name contains "schema" under src/lib/server/db/

threshold_choices.question: Extra exclusions for the team-lead signals (secrets / cloud / UI screenshots) that the plan table does not name
options: a: none beyond the plan table
b: also .env*, Dockerfile*, docker-compose*, .storybook/, playwright config, site/ (static LP pages), static/, *-baseline/ directories

threshold_choices.question: When an added line "overlaps" the issue body
options: a: line with >= 30 non-whitespace chars appears verbatim (whitespace removed) in the body
b: same with >= 20 chars
c: same with >= 20 chars, but only lines that are not already in the pre-fix version of the changed files
threshold_choices.note: counts for option a are recorded per item as leak_lines_ge30

threshold_choices.question: When the issue body "names" a changed file
options: a: full repository path of a changed implementation file appears in the body
b: full path or bare file name (with extension) of a changed implementation file appears
threshold_choices.note: both counts are recorded; the stratum flag uses b (the wider reading, so fewer items count as "not named")

threshold_choices.question: What puts an item in the heavy stratum
options: a: label priority:critical on issue or PR
b: a, or PR head branch starts with hotfix/ or a label contains "hotfix", or issue/PR title contains 再発
c: b, or issue body contains 再発
threshold_choices.note: c was not chosen: a body-level match would mostly hit boilerplate wording, which is not the plan stratum

threshold_choices.question: How the two strata are merged into one fixed order
options: a: all heavy first, then normal
b: alternate heavy, normal, heavy, ... (heavy first); inside a stratum newest merge first, then PR number descending, then sha256(seed:number); when one stratum is exhausted the other continues

threshold_choices.question: Training-cutoff rule
options: a: keep only merges after the published cutoff of the subject model
b: cutoff not established from a primary source -> no item is rejected on it; merge date is recorded for later stratification
